  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    c.visited || p.equipmentno

  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),

  SELECT
    room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo,

    room.equipmentdesc AS ConferenceRoom,

    d.equipmentdesc    AS DeviceDesc,

    d.manufacturer AS Manufacturer,

    d.assetstatus_display AS LeafStatus,

    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3) AS p3
  FROM rooms
)
SELECT __value, __text
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(p1,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p1n, regexp_replace(p1,'^\d+','') AS p1s,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(p2,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p2n, regexp_replace(p2,'^\d+','') AS p2s,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(p3,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p3n, regexp_replace(p3,'^\d+','') AS p3s
  FROM fmt
) q
ORDER BY p1n NULLS LAST, p1s, p2n NULLS LAST, p2s, p3n NULLS LAST, p3s, __value;

list.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  SELECT dp.position AS start_pos, p.equipmentno AS cur_pos, p.parentasset AS parent_pos,
         0 AS depth, ARRAY[p.equipmentno] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.start_pos, p.equipmentno, p.parentasset, c.depth + 1, c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
listed AS (
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    d.equipmentno    AS DeviceNo
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr     ON pr.start_pos = d.position
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    ('${room:raw}' = '__all' OR room.equipmentno IN (${room:sqlstring}))
    AND d.assetstatus_display = 'Installed'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM listed;
